contentPattern.structure: question (title) + answer (rich text) per item; expandable via native details/summary

suitableFor: any expand/collapse Q&A or 'learn more' toggled sections
compact stacks of related topics the reader selectively reveals
notSuitableFor: content that must be fully visible at once (use default content)
tabbed content switchers (use a tabs block)

notes: NEW block for this project (no local base accordion block existed). Based on the AEM Block Collection accordion, adapted for this OLDER boilerplate: the moveInstrumentation import was REMOVED (scripts.js does not export it — DA project, not Universal Editor/xwalk), and no fetchPlaceholders is used. Implementation uses only standard DOM APIs — native <details>/<summary> for accessible, JS-free toggling. CSS classes scoped to accordion-faq; relies on --light-color and --background-color, both defined in styles/styles.css. DA project, so no _accordion-faq.json model file. Block table content model: 2 columns, one row per FAQ item (cell1 = question title, cell2 = answer rich text). Source DOM was a genuine AEM Accordion component (div.cmp-accordion) with 7 items.
